parsed.summary: The netlist implements the intended CF-Chef architecture: ESP32-C3 SPI thermocouple sensing, heater high-side switch control, power mux/buck regulation, USB-C/12 V inputs, fan tach protection, and WS2812 status LED. Reference designators are renumbered relative to the specification, but the observed connectivity and values match the documented design; the remaining differences are either reference-numbering changes or already-documented known limitations, not anomalies.
